description: This file defines a public enum 'OpenClawNodeStorage' that provides static functions to retrieve specific directory URLs within the application's support and caches directories, handling session keys and directory availability. It acts as a utility for managing storage paths related to the OpenClaw application.

methods.name: appSupportDir
methods.description: Returns the URL to the application's support directory, throwing an error if unavailable.

methods.name: canvasRoot
methods.description: Constructs a URL for the 'canvas' directory within the app support directory, based on a session key.

methods.name: cachesDir
methods.description: Returns the URL to the caches directory, throwing an error if unavailable.

methods.name: canvasSnapshotsRoot
methods.description: Constructs a URL for the 'canvas-snapshots' directory within the caches directory, based on a session key.
